system.description:
An act of pure focus, sacrificing peripheral awareness for total concentration on one target.

Choose a target you can see and Lock On to them as a Swift Action. This effect lasts until the end of the next Monster Phase.

While Locked On:

  • You are considered Senseless to all other creatures except your target.
  • Against your target: +2 bonus to all Attack Rolls, Reflex Rolls, and Evasions.
  • If you Dodge an Attack from your target successfully, you may also move 2 spaces in any direction without expending Movement.

Ending Lock On early costs 1 Stamina as you force your body to recalibrate.
